The files in this directory are the sample corpus shipped with Google's
Snappy project (https://github.com/google/snappy, `testdata/`).

They are covered by `COPYING.notestdata` (BSD 3-Clause, Google Inc.), not by
Snappy's Apache-2.0 license. The license text is reproduced in `LICENSE`.

They are used only as benchmark and interop test data; the package does not
redistribute or modify them in any other way.
